skill.name: canvas-design
skill.description: Create polished PNG and PDF visual artwork from a design philosophy, using abstract composition, restrained text, and bundled fonts.
skill.summary: Create design-forward static artwork with a written visual philosophy and refined canvas output.
skill.author: ZhanlinCui

security_audit.summary: All static system-reconnaissance and external-command hits were false positives in license text or Markdown prose. Bundled binary font files were manually checked with font tooling and resolved as font assets, with no evidence of scripts, network access, secret access, or prompt injection.

remediation.issue: Bundled binary font assets reduce review transparency.
remediation.suggestion: Publish source URLs and checksums for each bundled font so reviewers can verify provenance quickly.

content.value_statement: Static visual work often lacks cohesive art direction. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to create refined PNG or PDF artwork with matching design philosophy.
actual_capabilities: Creates a written visual philosophy before rendering the design.
Guides one-page PNG or PDF artwork with restrained text.
Uses bundled font files for typographic variety when available.
Encourages abstract composition, patterns, spacing, and color systems.
Supports multi-page visual series when the user requests it.
limitations: Does not provide drawing code or an automated renderer by itself.
Bundled binary font files require trust in local font parsing tools.
Best suited for static artwork, not interactive interfaces or animation.
May prioritize artistic interpretation over literal information design.

use_cases.title: Poster Concept Direction
use_cases.description: Turn a broad theme into a refined poster with a clear visual philosophy and sparse text.

use_cases.title: Editorial Art Plate
use_cases.description: Create a single-page abstract visual for essays, reports, exhibits, or digital publications.

use_cases.title: Brand Mood Exploration
use_cases.description: Explore typography, color, and composition before committing to a formal identity system.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Poster
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one static design
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a single PNG poster about [topic]. Use a refined visual philosophy, minimal text, and strong composition.

prompt_templates.title: Develop Art Direction
prompt_templates.scenario: Building a design language before output
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a design philosophy for [subject], then express it as a polished PDF artwork with restrained typography.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Subtle Reference Piece
prompt_templates.scenario: Creating abstract work with hidden context
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a PNG artwork that subtly references [niche topic]. Keep the reference sophisticated and visually embedded.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Multi-Page Visual Series
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for related static outputs
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a three-page PDF series for [theme]. Give each page a distinct variation of the same visual philosophy.

output_examples.input: Create a poster for a quiet listening room.
output_examples.output: A short visual philosophy named Acoustic Stillness, followed by a restrained PNG poster with soft geometry and sparse labels.

output_examples.input: Make an abstract PDF about a research lab.
output_examples.output: A one-page PDF concept using systematic marks, clinical typography, and layered spatial patterns.

output_examples.input: Create a visual series for a poetry event.
output_examples.output: A three-page PDF sequence with related compositions, different pacing, and consistent typographic restraint.

best_practices: Provide the subject, mood, audience, and required output format.
Ask for a single page first when exploring an unfamiliar direction.
Review text placement carefully before exporting the final asset.
anti_patterns: Do not request a dense document with long explanatory text.
Do not expect interactive behavior, animation, or application UI output.
Do not ask it to copy a living artist or protected brand style.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates static visual artwork as PNG or PDF, supported by a written design philosophy.

faq.question: Can it make multi-page designs?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide multiple related pages when the prompt asks for a series or booklet.

faq.question: Does it include fonts?
faq.answer: Yes. The package includes bundled TrueType fonts and matching Open Font License files.

faq.question: Is it useful for production brand systems?
faq.answer: It is best for exploration and art direction, not final brand governance or legal clearance.

faq.question: Can it create exact layout files?
faq.answer: It can guide final PNG or PDF output, but it does not include a dedicated layout application.

faq.question: How should I prompt it?
faq.answer: Give a topic, mood, output format, and any required words. Keep the text requirements short.
